'''Rich41787 Reacting With Power''' is a [[Light]] deck by Rich41787, published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls111.htm Reacting With Power], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040722032519/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls111.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
